rationale: The failure occurred because we landed on the locale homepage, which is not a PLP and thus has no product tiles. We add a deterministic PLP entry URL for en-jp (Down Jackets) and fallbacks, plus robust product grid/tile selectors and OneTrust cookie handling. URL rules enforce staying under /en-jp/, prefer category paths, rewrite the homepage to a known PLP, and block corporate/editorial subdomains that derail scraping.
code_hints: If no PLP grid appears within 6-8s on moncler.com/en-jp/, click the OneTrust cookie button (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) then navigate directly to the preferred PLP entry URL.

If still on the homepage, navigate via header: click link has-text('Men') then link has-text('Down Jackets') (fallback: has-text('Outerwear')). Wait for [data-component='ProductGrid'] before scraping.
After grid appears, scroll 2-3 viewports with small waits (300-500ms) to trigger lazy loading, then collect product tiles using item_link_fallback.
When opening PDPs, wait for price using [itemprop='price'] or [data-testid='price-current'] before extraction.
Guard against locale flips: if URL loses /en-jp/, programmatically re-open the same path under /en-jp/.
